prose:
A joint Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative statement certifies Alpöge's Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, moving the evidence beyond the earlier commentary-only record. It says the statement matches Mathlib, the library compiles, independent comparison tools match the target theorem, and several kernels accept an inert exported proof. [Andrew Sutherland's MIT verification register](https://math.mit.edu/~drew/grh/) separately details completed builds, axiom checks and independent checkers, while listing two runs still in progress.

This summary reports those sources' verification, not a build performed for this wiki. The MIT register limits its GRH statements to Dirichlet L-functions, not arbitrary Hecke or automorphic L-functions. Its detailed table also distinguishes older incompatible checker binaries, completed alternative runs and outstanding end-to-end checks; not every row is a pass. Formal verification and expert certification are materially stronger than an announcement, but understanding the mathematical ideas remains a further task. This library is distinct from the Masullo manuscript formalization.
highlights: Joint Lean FRO/Mathlib statement explicitly certifies the proof
It separates correct statement, compilation, matching and kernel validity
MIT register reports independent build and exported-proof checks
Some checker versions are incompatible and two runs remain pending
GRH scope in the MIT register is Dirichlet L-functions
No independent build was run by this wiki
Masullo is a separate formalization project
